title: Boldfit ProLift Adjustable Weight Bench
description: An adjustable training bench with a stated 250 kg weight capacity and eight backrest positions for incline, flat and decline workouts. Its triangular steel frame supports presses, rows, core work and lower-body training; resistance ropes are included.
